name: dnd2-plugin
description: Create and roll guest D&D 5.5e character sheets, display inline roll results and share dice events through private play sessions.

interface.longDescription: An editable D&D 5.5e character sheet for the 2024 rules: ability scores, saving throws, skills, hit points, Hit Dice, death saves, conditions, attacks, spell slots, prepared spells, features, equipment, coins and backstory. No account required. Drafts stay in your browser where the host permits; export JSON for a portable backup. Roll D20 Tests with Advantage or Disadvantage and damage, with results displayed inline in chat. Optionally connect a private guest play session to share dice events with an explicitly subscribed chat. Sessions expire after 24 hours and retain up to 1,000 rolls. Explicitly attach a draft to share it with ChatGPT. Compatible with fifth edition; no rulebook is included. Cloud saving and Quest Portal accounts are not provided.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a D&D 5.5e character.
